failure_examples.question: Rank customers by total deposits in Shariah-compliant accounts, with ties given the same rank.
failure_examples.predicted: SELECT customer_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(balance) DESC, customer_id) AS rank FROM deposits WHERE account_type = 'Shariah';
